资源一览

最近采集的资源状态

narrative.overview: A calm, Chinese-language operational surface. Restrained navy planes, precise connector lines and aligned resource rows make regional inventory understandable. Expression belongs to the region diagram and the quiet cyan/teal accents. Runtime resource data supplies the content.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate planes with meaningful borders and no ambient glow.
Clear selected context, consistent icon strokes and tabular numerals.
Explicit timestamps and visibly distinct offline, demo and unavailable states.

rules.name: The Data State Rule
rules.body: Styling must distinguish actual zero, unavailable values, sampled monitoring and Oracle raw measurement.

rules.name: The Context Rule
rules.body: Region selection filters resources without inventing geographic coordinates.

dos: Preserve stable alignment, Chinese control labels and keyboard focus.
Keep actual units and independent observation timestamps visible.
Respect reduced motion and native safe areas.
donts: Add fake telemetry, decorative mini-charts or geographic locations.
Imply monitoring is billable traffic, or forecasts enforce hard caps.
Remove the offline and demo provenance banners.
